title: cenostigma bracteosum
intro: Cenostigma bracteosum, commonly known as Brazilian guava, is a plant species native to Brazil. It is a medicinal plant with various health benefits, including its use in treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cenostigma bracteosum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
